summary: Single-piece flat-bottom 10 degree wedge backboard with a contained rounded-rectangle blind pocket and a separate 15 degree rearward surface groove open through both side edges.

external_references.description: Latest side-view markup defining a shallower rearward long-groove tilt.

assembly_story.installation: Place the complete flat underside directly on a horizontal desktop.

designs.description: Parametric 10 degree wedge backboard with contained pocket and 6 mm deep rearward 15 degree groove open through both side edges.
